title: HTTP requests and responses
description: Learn HTTP methods, headers, body formats, status codes and safe error semantics by testing a small request-response handler.
objectives: Explain the meaning of GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE
Choose accurate HTTP statuses and response media types
Return a predictable error representation for invalid requests
Test HTTP contracts without running an external server
rubric: I explained safe and idempotent HTTP method semantics.
I distinguished media type, malformed body and invalid input errors.
I completed the request handler and passed its contract tests.
